voice.summary: Weavegate writes the way a careful administrator would want it: explicit, ordered and complete. It never hides inherited rules behind a friendly word, and it says what changed.
dos: Say whether a permission is inherited or an exception
Name the role and the resource in each sentence
Confirm what was saved and what was discarded
donts: Do not use vague words like some access
Never imply a change is saved before it is

taglines: Every role, every right, in view
boilerplate: Weavegate is an access console that shows what every role can do across workspaces, separating inherited access from editable exceptions with explicit review before saving.

microcopy.error: Could not save the policy. Your edits are still here.

logo.note: A woven grid reflects the matrix of roles and permissions.
